name: Awaken Tax
tagline: Crypto tax accounting: review and fix transactions, cost basis, gains and income in Awaken Tax.
description:
Awaken Tax is crypto tax software for DeFi, NFTs, perps and memecoins. Its hosted MCP server lets Cline work directly in your Awaken workspace:

- Search and review transactions from your connected wallets and exchanges, with transfers, fees and ledger entries
- Label, split, merge and correct transactions, with edit history and undo
- Investigate missing or implausible cost basis and trace an asset's tax lots
- Summarize realized gains and losses, income, top P&L assets and performance by chain
- Check portfolio value and positions
- Reconcile 1099-DA forms against your records
- Generate tax reports and CSV exports

Write tools only run when you grant read + write access. Cline connects with an Awaken API key (Settings -> API Keys; Dolphin or Whale plan).

install.notes: Replace <portfolioId>:<apiKey> with your Awaken portfolio ID and API key, joined by a colon. Create the key in Awaken under Settings -> API Keys, which also shows the portfolio ID. API keys need an Awaken Dolphin or Whale plan.
